name: XCC_ACCT_GROUP_USER_PREFS
description: This table contains user preferences for infolets display. This table includes details of budget account group and budget account in the budget account group.

columns.name: ACCT_GROUP_USER_PREF_ID
columns.description: User preference identifier for account group.

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: User identifier who set up the account group and budget account preference.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Account group identifier that represents account group selected by user.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Account group detail identifier that represents account group detail selected by user.

columns.name: DISPLAY_PREFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: Controls display of funds available in absolute amount or percentage of budget. Possible values are AMOUNT and PERCENT.

columns.name: DISPLAY_AMOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Controls display of amount type as most spent budgets or lowest funds available. Possible values are MOST_SPENT and LOWEST_FUNDS_AVAILABLE.

columns.name: TILE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of tile associated with preference.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
